preflight.storage: No durable mutation before A05 acknowledgement and available secure service. Sensitive write without explicit category scope invokes X08 then returns to original task. Local-only fields never enter durable command.
preflight.teaching: Before a task requiring missing concepts, create lessonReturn=task and queue earliest missing concept lessons in declared dependency order; after_lesson returns through queue. Do not insert an already queued concept recursively. Explicit familiar per-topic can satisfy vocabulary prerequisite without marking seen.
preflight.known_answer: Outside edit mode skip only a current confirmed answer to the applicable resolver; unresolved required data remains visible. All applicable personal-review acknowledgments set personalContextReady; O01 personal then reaches O03, never loops.
preflight.category_scope: O05→O06 requires supported category/year/resolved geography; otherwise X04. O07/O09 current snapshot required, else O06; F00 Revisit options without a valid snapshot goes O00.
preflight.personal_entry: O01 personal and O07 Add personal context set flow.personalReview=true. If prior recipient/knowledge exist do not ask again. Compare entry into personal review preserves compare goal and desired category.
preflight.proposed_other: X01 confirmation returns to original option resolver with confirmed supported value. Keeping unknown uses that field’s explicit unknown branch; if none exists shows unresolved continuation and useful summary, never a generated insurance rule.
